note: Team page. Images live in site/assets/img/team/. The chain of command follows docs/guides/HP-POL-007 (ADR 0013), departments follow docs/departments.md, seats follow docs/governance.md.

members.name: TrueMan
members.bio: Founded Hound Protocol and Joint Operations. Sets the direction, the priorities and the final decisions.

departments.name: Administration
departments.job: Direction, decisions, legal stance, funding, accounts, community and moderation.

departments.name: Development
departments.job: Builds Joint Operations: architecture, game hooks, networking, session, launcher, tools and website.

departments.name: Quality
departments.job: Tests on Windows and Proton, reviews every contract against its acceptance criteria, signs off releases.

departments.name: Contractor
departments.job: Outside contributors who take contracts, deliver and leave whenever they like. Graded E to S++ in each field.

principles: Everyone knows who decides what. Authority only flows down, and only in its own kind.
Anyone can talk to anyone, at any level. Public by default.
Decisions are written down with who and why. Moderation is logged. Roles are public.

social: Conduct, moderation, community spaces, disputes between people
technical: Architecture, code, merges, contract scope, releases
organizational: Roles, keycards, seats, recruiting, funding, legal stance

nodes.title: Owner
nodes.job: Final say in every kind of authority, and the last step of every appeal.

nodes.title: Administration
nodes.job: Runs the project: direction, accounts, recruiting, funding. Grants keycards up to LV5.

nodes.title: Moderators
nodes.job: Keep the community safe. Decide on conduct and disputes, and log every action.

nodes.title: Development
nodes.job: Builds Joint Operations. Decides architecture, code, merges and contract scope.

nodes.title: Quality
nodes.job: Tests and checks every delivery against its acceptance criteria. A failed check stops a release until it is fixed.

nodes.title: Contractors
nodes.job: Take contracts and deliver them. Graded E to S++ in each field; grades show experience, not authority.

nodes.title: Members
nodes.job: Everyone in the community. Can talk to anyone, follow sessions and report problems.
